prior_visual_inspection: Stage 8B already established visible target content in the exact three PNGs. Stage 8C formation reused source hashes, PNG headers and palettes, labels, and control-point metadata but did not decompress or numerically score image pixels.
frozen_regions: Three whole-annulus cells from 1.25 to 4.25 crater radii, derived only from official target coordinates, official diameters, and label control points; use zero-based integer column and row centers with lower-inclusive, upper-exclusive ring boundaries.
frozen_primary_endpoint: For each target, exact histogram AUC comparing inner-annulus RGB palette code-value lightness with its outer local annulus; require AUC >= 0.55 for both, excess-similarity >= 0.75, and Glushko excess strictly greater than Ohm excess.
frozen_robustness: The primary middle cell and at least two of three cells must pass separately in each admitted view for the strong state.
stop_rule: Stop after the joint-frame and matched-pair cells. Do not add images, draw rays from the outcome, change channels, retune thresholds, or turn camera code values into photometry or perception.
